arms.purpose: keeps the residual rather than discarding it

arms.content: X widened to A2's dimension with uninformative columns
arms.purpose: separates the transformation from the extra width

before_it_runs: external review of this design — the step v1's seal claimed for itself and which has not happened
dataset timestamp semantics and provider latency declared
an explicit development licence, which Musashi opens

decision_rule.multiplicity: Holm across all panels and candidate operators jointly; an abstention consumes its place

eligibility_conditions.requires: C62 batch membership row exists and the batch is EXACT
the v2 terminal's outcome is MEASURED
the v2 terminal's source.sha256 is present and matches the file read

eligible_set.why: no dataset declares what its timestamp MEANS, so every column's earliest availability is UNAVAILABLE. The condition is stated and enforced rather than quietly dropped

grants_nothing: a design describes what would be done. It confers no eligibility, opens no screen and carries no licence
paired_budget: every arm sees the same data, origins, seeds and wall-clock budget; unequal budget is the cheapest way to fake an improvement

supersedes.why: a seal asserts that an EXTERNAL party fixed the document before any score could influence it. No external party had seen it. Hashing my own design establishes only that I have not changed it since. An author cannot seal his own design any more than he can review it

withdrawal_conditions: the CAUSAL_ACTIVE set falls below a pre-fixed minimum
C49 coverage stops being complete for the panels in scope
the budget ceiling cannot be met with paired arms
a candidate operator is found non-causal after the population is fixed
any batch in scope stops being EXACT
